Spot price doesn’t tell you what a deal costs.

Premium

The dealer’s markup above metal value. Compare premium per ounce—not just sticker price.

02

All-in cost

Product price + payment fee + shipping. Gold Shark ranks this number first.

03

Round trip

The buy premium plus the resale discount. A lower round-trip spread protects your exit.
